## Problem

What task does this address? Link the issue if one exists.

## Changes

What changed, and what behavior should the reviewer expect?

## Acceptance evidence

| Criterion | Evidence | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Replace with a task criterion | Test, command, or manual check | Pass / Fail / Not run |

## Verification

List exact commands actually run and results. Explain failures and checks
not run. For documentation-only work, describe the links and content checked.

## Review

State whether review was independent, self-review, or pending.
List unresolved findings and limitations.

## Risks and rollout

Describe relevant compatibility, migration, or operational concerns.
Write "Not applicable" when there are none.

## Handoff

- [ ] The diff stays within the task scope.
- [ ] Each acceptance criterion has evidence or an explicit verification gap.
- [ ] Relevant checks were run, or limitations are recorded above.
- [ ] Human review is pending before merge.
